manual_baseline.rationale: Team-estimated baseline for an analyst preparing one consolidated geological/production intelligence report from eight mixed-format documents. The estimate assumes manual document location, reading, figure extraction, reconciliation, drafting, citation attachment, formatting, and review for a demo-scale CMPDI/CIL reporting workflow.
manual_baseline.disclosure: The manual baseline is a documented estimate, not a measured comparison against an actual manual process.

activities.activity: Read documents and extract relevant mining figures
Reconcile figures across geological, production, spreadsheet, OCR, and parliamentary sources
Compile report narrative and executive summary
Format, review, and prepare final response
activities.assumption: 15 minutes for final formatting and quality review

automation_workflow_steps.description: User uploads source documents through the API or UI.
automation_workflow_steps.current_system_basis: A human still chooses and uploads files.

automation_workflow_steps.description: Uploaded files are stored in MinIO with metadata recorded in PostgreSQL.
TXT, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, and image OCR extraction run in Celery.
Extracted text is split into chunks with source references.
Chunks are embedded for semantic retrieval.
automation_workflow_steps.current_system_basis: Implemented by the embedding Celery task.

automation_workflow_steps.description: Relevant chunks are retrieved for Q&A and search.
Key figures are extracted for analytics and report support.
automation_workflow_steps.current_system_basis: Implemented through deterministic text parsing and report heuristics.

automation_workflow_steps.description: Report narrative is generated from processed chunk text.
Q&A and reports expose source documents or chunk citations.
automation_workflow_steps.current_system_basis: Implemented in Q&A citations and report source document sections.

automation_workflow_steps.description: Generated report metadata and content are persisted.
Structured extraction accuracy and validation rules are computed.
